name: China Master Logistics Co., Ltd.
summary: China Master Logistics Co., Ltd. operates as an integrated logistics company in China. It operates through Cross-Border Container Logistics; Engineering Logistics; and Resource Transshipment Logistics segments. The company offers freight forwarding services comprising booking agency, freight forwarding, TCR logistics, air parcel, customs clearance, supply chain management, over-seas network, and consultation solutions.
